paragraphs: Rav Yosef ben Zimra. See the entry R' Yosi ben Zimra the Kohen.[^1]

notes.text: The heading explicitly writes Rav Yosef; the target has Yosi the Kohen, with abbreviated title rendered R'. Yosef and Yosi remain distinct. Kohen preserves the priestly qualifier without determining the abbreviated personal title.
